policy.scope: exact tested mechanism/configuration and exact pinned O snapshot only

scale.high: materially decision-relevant to current O bottlenecks or near-term evaluation/control
scale.medium_high: useful O-adjacent experiment but indirect or adaptation-heavy
scale.medium: future substrate value with weak immediate fit
scale.low_medium: interesting fallback with large transfer uncertainty

assessments.overlap: O has freshness/source-clock invalidation but not representation-drift alarms.
assessments.active_uncertainty: A quantitative semantic-drift trigger could complement context invalidation and stale-state control.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer from representation drift to O semantic/tool trajectories and exact alarm semantics remain untested.

assessments.overlap: O lacks a runnable same-label drift score/threshold substrate.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Can supply a controlled chronological score stream for comparing alarm controllers without inventing the representation benchmark.
assessments.uncertainty: Released protocol is window classification; temporalization is an adaptation.

assessments.overlap: O has no persistence/freeze drift controller.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Explicit FAR/delay and post-alarm freeze give a concrete comparator for O drift/freshness alarms.
assessments.uncertainty: Needs an O-like score stream; source domain/implementation are indirect.

assessments.overlap: O has candidate proposal/protected checks but not structural candidate generation with target-only confidence fallback.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Could make reuse of prior/external hypotheses safer while retaining an explicit target-only downside envelope.
assessments.uncertainty: Finite-sample theorem is linear-regression-specific.

assessments.overlap: O reuses historical evidence but lacks explicit bias-bound admission with live target shadow.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Directly targets safe evidence reuse under task/distribution drift.
assessments.uncertainty: Structure-free unknown-bias guarantee remains open.

assessments.overlap: O has scoped candidate comparison but no statistical lower-bound-on-transfer-gain gate.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Could reduce repeated evaluation while preventing negative transfer when reusing old evidence/candidates.
assessments.uncertainty: Needs an O-specific gain estimator and protected target-only baseline.

assessments.overlap: O currently runs small paired route/task comparisons but no anytime-valid paired binary test.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Directly addresses optional stopping and pseudo-replication at the task level.
assessments.uncertainty: Uses a stronger conditional discordant-sign null; small-N power needs characterization.

assessments.overlap: O freezes bounded units but lacks an explicit estimand gate for adaptive internal sampling.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Clarifies that one frozen finalized task outcome should feed the outer test even if internal rollouts are dependent/adaptive.
assessments.uncertainty: Finalization must be symmetric/frozen or the target changes.

assessments.overlap: O has fixed-horizon exact comparisons but no backward-induced anytime-valid terminal test.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Could allow safe early looks without sacrificing the planned fixed-horizon endpoint test.
assessments.uncertainty: Composite-null conditional computation may be difficult.

assessments.overlap: O reports nominal task counts but not discordant information rate.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Can reveal when many paired tasks are informationally inert and prevent overconfidence from nominal N.
assessments.uncertainty: Expected-log-growth numbers need exact/simulated stopping distributions.

assessments.overlap: O has held-out/protected evaluation but attacker strength is not an explicit controlled variable.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Tests whether apparent monitor/control safety survives stronger held-out attacker search.
assessments.uncertainty: Narrow LinuxArena evidence with small families.

assessments.overlap: O already enforces source/blob-bound exact scope and contradiction preservation.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Provides an external artifact-level regression case for those existing provenance guards.
assessments.uncertainty: Mostly validates an existing O control principle rather than introducing a new mechanism.

assessments.overlap: O has no iterative hard-negative attacker mining for its evaluators/monitors.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Can test whether weak/static red-team generation materially understates vulnerabilities before protected acceptance.
assessments.uncertainty: One detector architecture and source-specific pipeline.

assessments.overlap: O has protected regressions but not adversarial subclass stratification.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Shows aggregate improvement can hide regressions in specific attack classes, directly informing stratified acceptance gates.
assessments.uncertainty: O needs task-relevant strata rather than copying HASTE categories.

assessments.overlap: O has recovery/retry triggers but not posterior fix-benefit versus damage-risk stopping.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Could prevent extra repair rounds from damaging already-valid state and replace fixed retry counts with value-based stopping.
assessments.uncertainty: Current evidence is plan validity rather than durable tool-state recovery.

assessments.overlap: O has checkpoints/fenced recovery but not detector-history-based historical target selection.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Supplies a concrete rollback-target heuristic for a future matched selector ablation.
assessments.uncertainty: Source couples trigger, target, restoration and re-decoding; gain is uncertain.

assessments.overlap: O already has manifest-bound effect authorization, revocation/freshness/binding rechecks and fail-closed commit guards.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Useful external stress-test template and corroboration for an already-evaluated O mechanism family.
assessments.uncertainty: Low novelty; hidden/bypass effects remain outside external guarantee.

assessments.overlap: O has candidate activation but no anytime-valid paired acceptor for repeated self-modification decisions.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Directly targets false durable commits under repeated adaptive testing.
assessments.uncertainty: Prompt-evolution setting and per-decision guarantee do not cover systematic bias.

assessments.overlap: O already separates model proposal from deterministic evidence/activation but lacks gated semantic-QD credit.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Measured phantom-win rates strengthen the case for deterministic/statistical persistence authority rather than trusting semantic diagnosis.
assessments.uncertainty: QD benefit itself is not isolated and several ablations are single runs.

assessments.overlap: O has durable repository lineage/matched evaluation but not repository MAP-Elites QD.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Public ancestry/evaluator traces could support controlled evaluator-noise replay under fixed candidate budgets.
assessments.uncertainty: QD superiority is not established and replay feasibility remains to be verified.

assessments.overlap: No astrocyte-gated associative memory exists in O.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Immediate value is primarily the reproducibility/metric defect, not a ready O mechanism experiment.
assessments.uncertainty: No corrected rerun/independent replication and large transfer distance from N=20 associative memory.

assessments.overlap: O has persistent Candidates/Episodes but no fully specified Memento-style no-memory control operator.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Warns against attributing common iteration gains to learning/memory without a matched control whose own transition operator is specified.
assessments.uncertainty: Paper-era control operator remains unresolved.

assessments.overlap: O already uses single-writer leases, fences, CAS/readback and protected mutation authority.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Provides an external code analogue for regression-testing the evidence-validity versus mutation-authority boundary.
assessments.uncertainty: Mostly confirms existing architecture; no live Argus exploit reproduction.

assessments.overlap: O has recursive units/strategy review but not theorem subgoal-focused parallel scheduling/replanning.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Provides a concrete scheduler alternative if O generalizes hierarchical subgoal control or theorem/program synthesis.
assessments.uncertainty: Planner gain is not compute-matched and immediate O path is not Lean theorem proving.

assessments.overlap: O has durable/context artifacts but no verified Lean-proof simplifier.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Suggests separating token compression from actual verifier/execution cost when optimizing reusable artifacts.
assessments.uncertainty: Completed-proof simplification is distinct from online trajectory/context compression.

assessments.overlap: O stages local validation before exact-head full CI but lacks an explicit representative-subset fidelity gate.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Could shorten expensive implementation/debug cycles while retaining full-fidelity final evaluation.
assessments.uncertainty: Subset choice can miss integration failures and MLE-Bench transfer is not guaranteed.

assessments.overlap: O has search-allocation metrics but no learned field/time-controlled community-impact prior.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Could diversify proposal triage under saturation while keeping validity authority with execution/evidence gates.
assessments.uncertainty: Community preference is biased and not truth; generated ideas lack prospective experimental validation.

assessments.overlap: O has persistent scoped Candidates and learning but not retrieval-aware risk, harmful-reuse attribution and retirement.
assessments.active_uncertainty: Could add a lifecycle gate so locally useful but persistently harmful/brittle updates are repaired or retired after reuse evidence.
assessments.uncertainty: Safety-targeted benchmark, utility tradeoffs and no independent replication; benign correctness analogue is needed.

exact_next_candidate: Same sealed c6 set is complete for relevance. Do not infer admission from relevance alone; await exact-matched evidence strength and join all three dimensions on c6 identity.
